gloss: opening act; lowest rank of rakugo performer

definitions.explanation: A performer or performance that comes before the main act at a show, concert or event, to warm up the audience.
The lowest of the three ranks of rakugo performers in Tokyo, an apprentice who opens the program and does the backstage chores, below {二|ふた}つ{目|め} and {真打|しんうち}.

- {前座|ぜんざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as the opening act
- {前座|ぜんざ}⟦{修業|しゅぎょう}→修業：16906_shugyou⟧: training as a zenza

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Tokyo rakugo the ranks are {前座|ぜんざ} → ⟦{二|ふた}つ{目|め}→二つ目：30351_futatsume⟧ → {真打|しんうち}. A zenza wears no haori jacket, opens the bill at the ⟦{寄席|よせ}→寄席：12389_yose⟧, and serves the masters backstage; Osaka has no formal rank system. In sense 1 the word can be used lightly of anything that comes before the main event, such as a short talk before a ceremony.
